output.summary: KEP-3314 proposes an optional CSI SnapshotMetadata gRPC API that lets backup applications list allocated blocks of a snapshot and changed blocks between snapshot pairs, served through an external-snapshot-metadata sidecar. The KEP is currently in status implementable at stage beta.
output.rationale:
Backup tools need efficient differential backups of CSI block volumes without loading the Kubernetes API server with large metadata payloads. The design adds a CSI service plus a community sidecar that handles auth and forwards calls to the driver over a UNIX socket, with a SnapshotMetadataService CR for discovery. The source says the aggregated API server alternative was rejected because large CBT payloads would be proxied through the API server.</rationale>

evidence.quote: The aggregated API server solution described in [#3367][0] was deemed unsuitable because of the potentially large amount of CBT payloads that will be proxied through the K8s API server.
The mechanism that enables this direct access utilizes a proxy service sidecar to shield the CSI drivers from managing the individual Kubernetes clients.
The previous design which involved generating and returning a RESTful callback endpoint to the caller, to serve CBT payloads was superceded by the aggregation extension mechanism
